what_this_shows: The first real Level 1 option order this system sent to a broker did NOT fill, and this is the record of why and of it being closed out cleanly. Submission, OCC symbology, the sell_to_open intent and the confirmation gate were all proven live (see submitted-CVX-option.json). What was not proven is a fill. The order was built while the market was closed, so its limit came from the previous session's bid; at the open the contract repriced below that limit and the sell-to-open was never marketable. It rested from 09:30 ET until cancelled. No partial fill, no position, no ledger write.
root_cause: The limit of 0.13 was the contract's bid as of the prior session's close, captured ~4h before the open. At 10:02 ET on 2026-08-20 the same contract quoted bid 0.07 / ask 0.17 / mid 0.12. A sell limit at 0.13 sits above the bid and above the mid, so it rests inside the spread rather than crossing. This is a stale-quote pricing error, not a defect in symbology, transport, or the gate chain.
already_fixed: Commit 4a73e6b makes check_market_clock() distinguish 'closed' from 'unreadable' and makes check_paper_order.py warn, before printing any price, that a closed-market quote is the previous session's and a limit built from it may never become marketable. The warning names this exact failure.

verification.note: By the time it was cancelled the contract's spread was far outside the 15%-of-mid liquidity filter option_strategy applies at selection, so this contract would no longer be selected at all. A 1-DTE deep-OTM contract is where that filter earns its keep.

ledger_after_cancel.note: Both still contain only the queue-5 CVX equity trade. Queue 7 wrote nothing.

what_happens_next: Queue 7 is closed and cannot be revived. A replacement cash-secured put was priced against a live open-market quote and approved as queue 8 (AAPL260826P00305000, sell-to-open 1 contract, limit 0.69 at the bid, 3.7% OTM, 6 DTE). CVX had no eligible contract at all today -- 46 rejected as outside the 2-7% OTM band -- and the band was deliberately NOT widened to force a trade. Queue 8 has cleared all three gates but has reached no broker: submitting it requires the project owner to type EXECUTE PAPER personally. That confirmation does not carry over from queue 7.

quote_shortly_after_cancel.note: Read at 14:14Z, about nine minutes after the 14:04:52Z cancellation, so it is corroboration rather than the state at the moment of cancel. It tells the same story: bid 0.07 against a 0.13 resting sell limit.

quote_at_10_02_ET.note: Read while the order was still resting, ~2 minutes before it was cancelled. This is the reading the root cause is argued from.

reconciled.why_this_matters: The reconcile path had only ever been exercised on a fill. This proves it also closes out a terminal NON-fill correctly: lifecycle_status maps 'canceled' to BROKER_CANCELLED, portfolio_sync is null, and neither paper_positions nor paper_fills was written. A cancelled order books nothing.
